messages:
tess: Hey team — BlueSprig interview went well. Need quick decisions: transcript redaction, quote approval, embargo date, and lead-routing tags. Recording + raw transcript in Drive: https://drive.redwood.ai/blue-sprig-interview. Can legal + ops weigh in?

leo: Nice! Couple things — they called out a benchmark stat (30s latency median) that we want to highlight in the webinar slide. Legal: okay to surface a sanitized stat (percent change) instead of raw telemetry?

anita: Prefer we avoid raw telemetry in public. Use a rounded stat (e.g., "~50% lower inference cost") and no exact p95/p99 numbers. Also need localization for DE/FR captions — can content team deliver by EOD Mon? :clock1:

legal-bot: Automated check: NDA on file and release form received. Recommend redacting exact request IDs and any customer PII (emails, internal hostnames). Please use customer-release-v2 template for the final consent. Flagging requirement: written sign-off on the final transcript before publish.

max: I can handle transcript redlines and produce a 60s social clip + 3x 30s webinar cutouts. Quick question @tess — can we quote them verbatim saying "Redwood halved our inference cost" or should we paraphrase? :thinking_face:

tess: They approved the gist but asked to avoid exact months and internal metrics. Suggested public wording: "reduced our inference costs by ~50%". That should be fine and defensible. :thumbsup:

anita: OK. For lead-routing, mark this as `high-touch` and `benchmark-interest`. Route inbound demo requests from the asset to AE Sam (sam@redwood.ai). @leo can you add the tracking pixel and UTM parameters so leads come through the right flow? Embargo: please hold until 2026-04-02 09:00 PT.

leo: Got it — I'll drop the pixel + UTM in the landing template and sync with Sam on the routing. Will also create a short funnel flow in HubSpot.

legal-bot: Confirming provisional legal sign-off pending final redlined transcript. Add a comment in the release form once redlines are complete and legal will flip to green.

max: I'll upload the redlined transcript and the social clips to the same Drive folder and ping when done. ETA: 5:00 PM PT today.

anita: Great — once max posts the redlines, I'll schedule a quick 15-min review with legal and ops to close out the embargo checklist. Thanks everyone. :raised_hands:
